name: Treehouse Jumpers
summary: Treehouse Jumpers is a wild, whimsical game where you don't walk—you handstand. In this topsy-turvy world, the ground is just a suggestion and your palms are your feet. Players navigate a surreal treetop village by walking on their hands, leaping between swaying platforms, balancing across ropes, and vaulting from branch to branch in gravity-defying acrobatics.
